theorem scratch_divFunctorAff_existsUnique_of_etaleCover
    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    {n : Nat} (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
    {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D)
    (F : divFamZarAff C n (overSpec k E.Carrier))
    (hF :
      divFamZarAff.map C n
          (Over.overSpecMap (doubleInl (k := k) E)) F =
        divFamZarAff.map C n
          (Over.overSpecMap (doubleInr (k := k) E)) F) :
    existsUnique fun F0 : divFamZarAff C n (overSpec k A) =>
      divFamZarAff.map C n
        (Over.overSpecMap
          ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)) F0 = F := by
  let d : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ overSpec k A :=
    Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
  let d0 : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInl (k := k) E)
  let d1 : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInr (k := k) E)
  let b : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ D := rep.homEquiv.symm F
  let g : Spec (.of E.Carrier) ⟶ Spec (.of A) := d.left
  letI : Surjective g := by
    dsimp only [g, d, Over.overSpecMap_left]
    exact ⟨E.comap_surjective⟩
  haveI : Etale g := by
    dsimp only [g, d, Over.overSpecMap_left]
    rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
  have hdoubleHom : d0 ≫ b = d1 ≫ b := by
    apply rep.homEquiv.injective
    rw [rep.homEquiv_comp, rep.homEquiv_comp, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hF
  have hdoubleLeft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hdoubleHom
  have hfst :
      (pullbackSpecIso A E.Carrier E.Carrier).inv ≫ pullback.fst g g = d0.left := by
    rw [pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst]
    rfl
  have hsnd :
      (pullbackSpecIso A E.Carrier E.Carrier).inv ≫ pullback.snd g g = d1.left := by
    rw [pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd]
    rfl
  have hkernel :
      pullback.fst g g ≫ b.left = pullback.snd g g ≫ b.left := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (pullbackSpecIso A E.Carrier E.Carrier).inv,
      Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hfst, hsnd]
    exact hdoubleLeft
  have hbase : ∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}}
      (p1 p2 : Z ⟶ Spec (.of E.Carrier)),
      p1 ≫ g = p2 ≫ g → p1 ≫ b.left = p2 ≫ b.left := by
    intro Z p1 p2 hp
    let z : Z ⟶ pullback g g := pullback.lift p1 p2 hp
    calc
      p1 ≫ b.left = (z ≫ pullback.fst g g) ≫ b.left := by rw [pullback.lift_fst]
      _ = z ≫ (pullback.fst g g ≫ b.left) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = z ≫ (pullback.snd g g ≫ b.left) := congrArg (fun m => z ≫ m) hkernel
      _ = (z ≫ pullback.snd g g) ≫ b.left := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = p2 ≫ b.left := by rw [pullback.lift_snd]
  let a : Spec (.of A) ⟶ D.left := EffectiveEpi.desc g b.left hbase
  have ha : g ≫ a = b.left := EffectiveEpi.fac g b.left hbase
  have haOver : a ≫ D.hom = (overSpec k A).hom := by
    apply (cancel_epi g).1
    calc
      g ≫ (a ≫ D.hom) = (g ≫ a) ≫ D.hom := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = b.left ≫ D.hom := congrArg (fun m => m ≫ D.hom) ha
      _ = (overSpec k E.Carrier).hom := b.w
      _ = g ≫ (overSpec k A).hom := d.w.symm
  let aOver : overSpec k A ⟶ D := Over.homMk a haOver
  have hda : d ≫ aOver = b := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    exact ha
  refine ⟨rep.homEquiv aOver, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      divFamZarAff.map C n d (rep.homEquiv aOver) =
          rep.homEquiv (d ≫ aOver) := (rep.homEquiv_comp d aOver).symm
      _ = rep.homEquiv b := congrArg rep.homEquiv hda
      _ = F := rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply F
  · intro F' hF'
    have hda' : d ≫ rep.homEquiv.symm F' = b := by
      apply rep.homEquiv.injective
      rw [rep.homEquiv_comp, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hF'
    have hleft : (rep.homEquiv.symm F').left = a := by
      apply EffectiveEpi.uniq g b.left hbase
      exact congrArg Over.Hom.left hda'
    have hover : rep.homEquiv.symm F' = aOver := by
      apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
      exact hleft
    calc
      F' = rep.homEquiv (rep.homEquiv.symm F') :=
        (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply F').symm
      _ = rep.homEquiv aOver := congrArg rep.homEquiv hover

/-! ## Descent classes on an étale cover -/

/-- The first coprojection from the carrier of a cover into its self-tensor product over
the base — the algebra face of the first projection of the double cover
`Spec (B ⊗[A] B) → Spec B` — as a `k`-algebra map. -/
def doubleInl (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
  Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft

/-- The second coprojection into the self-tensor product; see `doubleInl`. -/
def doubleInr (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
  (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight).restrictScalars k

/-- The subgroup of relative Picard classes on an étale cover of the test algebra
satisfying the descent condition: equal pullbacks along the two projections of the double
cover. -/
def descentClasses (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    Subgroup (relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) :=
  MonoidHom.eqLocus

This round replaces prescriptive per-leaf tasks with FIVE lanes per project: one REVIEWER and four PROVERS ranked p1..p4. The provers each pick their own target. That only works if claiming is explicit and public. This item is the claiming mechanism. Read it before your first edit.\n\nTHE FIVE LANES PER PROJECT\n- `review-ajc` / `review-ajcr` \u2014 reviewer. Read-mostly. Finds defects of ROUTE and ORGANISATION, not of individual proofs; may propose refactors and file tasks-as-proposals for the provers. Does not race provers for proof work.\n- `ajc-p1` / `ajcr-p1` \u2014 takes the MOST important open representability item.\n- `-p2`, `-p3`, `-p4` \u2014 2nd, 3rd, 4th most important, where \"important\" is measured against the project's representability headline, not by ease.\n\nCLAIMING \u2014 do this BEFORE you start proving, not after.\n 1. `horizon roadmap list --focus <your project's w4-rep / picrep subtree>` and read the reviewer's open notes.\n 2. Pick your item. Check no other lane owns it: an item with `--owner` set to another lane IS CLAIMED. Do not take it, even if you think you would be faster.\n 3. Claim it: `horizon roadmap set <id> --owner <your-task-id> --status active`. If your target is not yet a roadmap item, `roadmap add` it under the right parent first, then claim it.\n 4. Announce: one `horizon inbox add --kind info --to horizon --body \"CLAIM <lane>: <roadmap id> \u2014 <one line on what discharging it buys>\"`.\n 5. Release on exit: if you did NOT finish, `roadmap set <id> --owner ''` and leave a one-line inbox note saying where you stopped and what the next lane should NOT re-derive. An item left owned by a dead lane is worse than an unclaimed one.\n\nRANK IS A TIE-BREAK, NOT A FENCE. If p1's item turns out to be blocked on p3's, say so in the inbox and swap \u2014 rank exists so four lanes do not all converge on the same top item, not to stop you working on the right thing. p1 has first refusal on any contested item.\n\nYOU MAY PROPOSE WORK TO THE OTHER LANES. Direct-message with `horizon inbox add --kind hint --to task:<lane-id> --body \"\u2026\"`. A good proposal names the declaration, the file, and why it is worth more than what that lane currently holds.
